optimal.idea: Fibonacci with two rolling variables.

brute.idea: Recurse minCost(i) = cost[i] + min(next two) without caching.

brute.idea: Recurse min cost from each index without caching.

optimal.idea: dp[i] = min over jumps of dp[i-1]+|h[i]-h[i-1]| (and dp[i-2]); roll variables.

brute.idea: Recurse pick/skip each house without caching.

optimal.idea: dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], dp[i-2] + nums[i]); roll two variables.

brute.idea: Recurse pick/skip on the two linear cases (drop first house, drop last) without caching.

optimal.idea: Houses are circular: run linear house-robber twice, excluding the first or last house.

brute.idea: Recurse from each index trying a 1-digit and 2-digit decode without caching.

optimal.idea: dp[i] adds dp[i-1] if the 1-digit is valid and dp[i-2] if the 2-digit (10-26) is valid.

brute.idea: Recurse trying every prefix as a dictionary word.

optimal.idea: dp[i] true if some j<i has dp[j] true and s[j:i] is in the dictionary.
dp[i] tries every partition length up to k ending at i, using that block's max*length.

brute.idea: Recurse over (day, lastActivity) without caching.

optimal.idea: dp[day][lastActivity] = max points, skipping the previous day's activity.

brute.idea: Recurse paths(i,j) = paths(i-1,j)+paths(i,j-1) without caching.

optimal.idea: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] + dp[i][j-1]; roll a single row (or the combinatorial formula).

brute.idea: Recurse paths(i,j) skipping obstacles, without caching.

optimal.idea: Same grid DP but set blocked cells to 0 paths.
dp[i][j] = grid[i][j] + min(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]).

dp[i][j] = a[i][j] + min of the three cells above (j-1, j, j+1).
dp[i][j] = 1 + min(top, left, top-left) when the cell is 1; sum all dp values.

brute.idea: Recurse over worst-case split at each trial floor without caching.

optimal.idea: dp[eggs][floors] over the worst-case split (or the O(e*f) moves reformulation).

brute.idea: Recurse take/skip each item without caching.

optimal.idea: Subset-sum for total/2 (impossible if total is odd).

Count dp[sum]: dp[s] += dp[s-num] per element (handle zeros carefully).

brute.idea: Recurse assigning + or - to each element, counting those that hit target.

optimal.idea: +/- assignment reduces to counting subsets summing to (total+target)/2.

brute.idea: Recurse trying every coin at each amount without caching.

optimal.idea: dp[a] = min(dp[a], dp[a-coin]+1) over coins and amounts.

brute.idea: Recurse over (coin index, remaining amount) counting combinations without caching.

optimal.idea: Count ways: for each coin, dp[a] += dp[a-coin] iterating amount upward.

brute.idea: Recurse on both indices, branching on match/mismatch without caching.

Build the LCS dp table, then backtrack from dp[n][m] to reconstruct the sequence.

brute.idea: Recurse on (i,j): if ends match 2+inner else max of dropping either end, without caching.

optimal.idea: dp[i][j] counts ways; on match add dp[i-1][j-1], always add dp[i-1][j].

brute.idea: Recurse on both indices trying insert/delete/replace without caching.

brute.idea: Check every substring for palindrome-ness.

optimal.idea: Expand around each of the 2n-1 centers, counting palindromes.

brute.idea: Recurse take/skip tracking the previous element without caching.

optimal.idea: Maintain a tails array; binary-search the position to replace/extend per element.
